Definition: from G4243; seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors):--ambassage, message.
BiblicalUsage: Presbeia is an embassy, a message sent by ambassadors. Luke uses it twice: a king sends an ambassage to ask for peace while the enemy is far off, and the citizens of the nobleman send a message after him saying, we will not have this man to reign over us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every embassy carries a choice, and the message we send heaven decides whose reign we live under.
